source.question: Why did F-12's oil rate jump after the December 2014 shutdown?

submission.summary: F-12's oil rate jumped about 4.7 times after the 32-day December 2014 shut-in, most likely because its water cut collapsed from 96% to 31% while the choke was cut to about 30%. Liquid fell from about 4,920 Sm3/d to 1,250 Sm3/d yet oil rose from 185 Sm3/d to 860 Sm3/d, consistent with water no longer taking the well's capacity.

findings.claim: F-12 was shut in 32 days from 2014-11-30 to 2014-12-31 and restarted with oil up 366% to 860 Sm3/d from 185 Sm3/d.
findings.detail: detect_events F-12 shut_in 2014-11-30 to 2014-12-31, days 32, rate_before 184.54 -> rate_after 859.51 Sm3/d, relative_change 3.66, field_wide with F-1 C, F-15 D; daily 2014-11-20 oil 184.03 water 4746 choke 100.0 vs 2015-01-02 oil 782.75 water 226.18 choke 26.5

findings.claim: The jump was a water-cut collapse at lower choke and liquid: water cut 96% to 31% while monthly liquid fell to 1,250 Sm3/d from 4,920 Sm3/d and choke to 30% from 97%.
findings.detail: production_monthly 2014-11: water_cut 0.9623, choke_pct 96.52, monthly liquid proxy 4923 at choke 100.0; 2015-01: water_cut 0.3107, choke_pct 30.33, liquid 1251 at 30.28 choke, oil_rate_per_producing_day 185.7 -> 862.38; daily confirms choke 100.0 -> 26.5, water_cut 0.9627 -> 0.2242, liquid ~4980 -> ~1009 Sm3/d; by_year water_cut 0.9634 in 2014 -> 0.6416 in 2015

findings.claim: This was not a field pressure surge: field voidage replacement was about 1.0 and F-14's rate showed no jump, staying about 305 Sm3/d.
findings.detail: waterflood 2014 field voidage replacement_ratio 1.02, 2015 0.9995 near 1 means injection kept pace at reservoir conditions (Bo 1.385); F-14 production_monthly 2014-11 oil_rate_per_producing_day 351.83 water_cut 0.9087 -> 2014-12 313.11 -> 2015-01 304.82 water_cut 0.9124 flat, production on 30/30/31 days

result.summary: 30-day median water_cut first goes above 0.05 on 2009-10-31, 21 months after first oil.
30-day median water_cut first goes above 0.5 on 2010-06-04, 28 months after first oil.
Shut in for 12 days from 2010-08-16. Oil rate 1,821 -> 2,000 Sm3/d (+10%) after restart. Same time as F-14.

bhp_bar reads 0 on 2095 days from 2010-10-12 to 2016-09-17 while the well kept flowing on 1830 days (1,133,053 Sm3 oil): a sensor failure, not a pressure collapse. Last good reading: 253.9 on 2010-10-11.
Shut in for 10 days from 2011-06-21. Oil rate 1,144 -> 1,364 Sm3/d (+19%) after restart. Same time as F-14.
Shut in for 20 days from 2011-10-16. Oil rate 955 -> 1,158 Sm3/d (+21%) after restart. Same time as F-14.
Shut in for 11 days from 2012-01-03. Oil rate 1,063 -> 1,028 Sm3/d (-3%) after restart. Same time as F-14.
30-day median water_cut first goes above 0.8 on 2012-02-14, 48 months after first oil.
Shut in for 46 days from 2012-08-14. Oil rate 691 -> 728 Sm3/d (+5%) after restart. Same time as F-14.
Shut in for 13 days from 2013-03-12. Oil rate 531 -> 572 Sm3/d (+8%) after restart.
Shut in for 9 days from 2014-05-16. Oil rate 194 -> 193 Sm3/d (-1%) after restart.
Shut in for 32 days from 2014-11-30. Oil rate 185 -> 860 Sm3/d (+366%) after restart. Same time as F-1 C, F-15 D.
Shut in for 36 days from 2016-08-13. Same time as F-14, F-15 D, F-5.

issues.text: water cut above 0.80 (now 0.85); the platform was designed for 0.80
oil rate stepped down 60%, weekly mean 1,259 -> 509 Sm3/d
31 days shut in over the last 180

result.levels: alarm: act now; caution: watch; note: for the record

result.no_trend: WOR is not rising with cumulative oil on 2013-05 to 2016-08: no limit can be projected
result.notes: WOR = water/oil by month; the trend is log10(WOR) against cumulative oil, fitted on up to 36 recent months with WOR >= 1. field_voidage: replacement_ratio is injection over voidage at reservoir conditions (Bo 1.385 m3/Sm3 from PUD p.20, low/high with Bo 1.5/1.27; Bw 1; above the bubble point, so no free gas); surface_ratio is the same in surface volumes, which overstates replacement.

arguments.sql:
SELECT date, well, on_stream_hrs, oil_sm3, water_sm3, water_cut, choke_pct, liquid_rate_proxy FROM
 (SELECT date, well, on_stream_hrs, oil_sm3, water_sm3, water_cut, choke_pct, (oil_sm3+water_sm3) as liquid_rate_proxy FROM production_daily WHERE well='F-12' AND date BETWEEN '2014-11-01' AND '2015-02-28' ORDER BY date)
 LIMIT 200

arguments.query: F-12 workover intervention water shut off

arguments.sql: SELECT date, well, on_stream_hrs, oil_sm3, water_sm3, water_cut, choke_pct, bhp_bar, whp_bar FROM production_daily WHERE well IN ('F-12','F-11','F-14','F-15 D','F-1 C') AND date BETWEEN '2014-11-20' AND '2015-01-15' ORDER BY date, well LIMIT 200
